evidence.quote:
now requires a signed release
manifest before it ships

observations.why: A position-holder issues a binding requirement that frames deployment as contingent on a mandated artifact — authority of process, not persuasion.

evidence.quote:
two unsigned artifacts reach staging
last quarter and that is the whole reason for the gate

observations.why: Supplies the factual basis for the gate and argues from that evidence — controlling the facts and reasoning from them simultaneously.
Restates the gate as a flat requirement — authority of an agreed process, no justification offered.
Extends the gate's jurisdiction by declaration — scope set by positional authority, not by consultation or appeal.
Assigns accountability by naming an owner — exercising authority to designate who holds the gate.

mints.name: GateAsMandate
mints.title: a requirement issued as a binding gate before action may proceed
mints.frame: Is the constraint here entering as a non-negotiable precondition set by position, rather than as a recommendation or appeal?
